name: Triceps Dips
steps: Grip parallel bars and lift yourself up with straight arms.
Keep your body upright and elbows close to your sides.
Bend your elbows to lower until upper arms are level with the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
cues: Breathe out as you push up

common_mistakes.fix: Stop when upper arms are level with the floor
Press shoulders down at the start of each rep
Keep legs still; use the assisted machine
